title: Queen Buys the File
setup: Your queen on h5 stares at h7 and your rook on d1 is one swing away from the h-file.
hint: The king cannot move a single square. What has to happen before your rook matters on the h-file?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qxh7+}} is a whole queen for one pawn, but {{Kxh7}} is forced. The h-file is bare, the pawn on f5 covers g6, and {{Rh1#}} arrives with nothing left to stop it. Material counts for nothing once the king has no square to stand on.
